verbatim_quotes.text: Delany-Moretlwe et al. 2022 South Africa, Botswana, Kenya, Eswatini, Malawi, Uganda, Zimbabwe HPTN084 study

HPTN_084.notes: HPTN 084 is a primary included study in this systematic review of CAB-LA use in pregnancy. The full text (PMC12613714) includes a data extraction table that lists HPTN 084 explicitly with 7 African countries: South Africa, Botswana, Kenya, Eswatini, Malawi, Uganda, Zimbabwe. Note: HPTN 083 (MSM and transgender women) was NOT included in this review; the focus was on CAB-LA in pregnancy and in cisgender women, meaning the included studies come from HPTN 084, HPTN 077, ATLAS-2M, FLAIR, SOLAR, and a compassionate use program. Layer (a): no explicit African-cohort count claim by trial name. Layer (b): TRUE — characteristics/data extraction table lists 7 African countries alongside HPTN 084 trial name. Layer (c): TRUE — trial name co-located with African country names in the same data-extraction table row. Search date: 31 December 2023.
